additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422187-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946] Connector out of order CRM:02698000098
additional_info.body:
Hello Ferdi,
Following a review of the system logs for DC2, several critical error flags have been identified. Kindly review the following summary and prepare accordingly for the upcoming site intervention:
1. Low Coolant Level – Cooling Unit EP1
Error:
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Lvlswitch
Issue:
Coolant level is below the critical threshold.
Action Required:
Top up coolant during site visit. Please carry the following spare part:
Spare Part:
Cooling Liquid Glysofor N 52% 10L
MLFB No.:
8EM5905-0AA00-0AA2
2. CAN Communication Error – Cooling Unit EP1 Fan/Pump
Error Flag:
CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan_or_Pump = TRUE
Details:
(BUS: 0 GSH: 1 GSS: 1 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 20)
Action Required:
Verify CAN line integrity between XD101 and KF11:
Check that the orange and white cables show 60 Ohms resistance using a multimeter.
Investigate the following possible causes:
Microcontroller CAN line issue (HW/FW error)
Loose wiring at XD12
Fault at KF11
Refer to the attached Knowledge Article for further detail:
KA:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan_or_Pump and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
3. Missing Power Converter in DC2
Issue:
One or more power converters are reported as missing.
Action Required:
Check for loose connections at all converters.
Use a multimeter to verify input voltage levels.
Identify missing converters via serial numbers and confirm power status.
Check for indicator lights or display errors.
If all checks are unsuccessful, proceed with a replacement. Please carry the following spare part:
Spare Part:
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
MLFB No.:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 (-TB1 to -TB15)
Refer to the attached Knowledge Article:
KA:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422187-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / N5 160345946] Connector out of order CRM:02698000098
additional_info.body:
Hey Liz,
Hope you are doing well.
As we understand, Glen will be onsite tomorrow to review this topic.
Our global team have reviewed the faults and identified the following:
Actions to be taken after following the 5 Electrical safety rules and checked with the charger off and de-energised.
1. Low Coolant Level – Cooling Unit EP1
Error:
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Lvlswitch
Issue:
Coolant level is below the critical threshold.
Action Required:
Check for any coolant leaks.
Section 9 of the repair manual shows details around the cooling system.
Top up coolant during site visit. Please carry the following spare part:
Spare Part:
Cooling Liquid Glysofor N 52% 10L
MLFB No.:
8EM5905-0AA00-0AA2
2. CAN Communication Error – Cooling Unit EP1 Fan/Pump
Error Flag:
CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan_or_Pump = TRUE
Details:
(BUS: 0 GSH: 1 GSS: 1 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 20)
Action Required:
Verify CAN line integrity between XD101 and KF11:
Check that the orange and white cables (XD12 Terminal 7 and 8) show 60 Ohms resistance using a multimeter.
Investigate the following possible causes:
Microcontroller CAN line issue (HW/FW error)
Loose wiring at XD12
Fault at KF11
3. Missing Power Converter in DC2
Issue:
One or more power converters are reported as missing.
Action Required:
Check for loose connections at all converters.
If all checks are unsuccessful, proceed with a replacement.
Replace Power Module with serial number 2102312VGQ10L60000024S.
Need to check all power modules for its location.
Please carry the following spare part:
Spare Part:
Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
MLFB No.:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 (-TB1 to -TB15)
As discussed during our call, I am available for a brief call with Glen tomorrow, if you require any additional support then we will need to send through an offer for the time.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

Problem Description:
Connector 2 out of order. Error logs indicating coolant level below critical.

Cooling system checked for leaks. No leaks found. Coolant topped up.
Coolant fault cleared. Power module is still missing and to be addressed at PM.
